decisions.reason: Naval vessel lighting is a niche, long-cycle specialist line where uncertainty about demand resolves slowly, and keeping it listed costs little relative to its option value in robust specialist markets.
The spring-balanced desk lamp has its own page and fits the firm's ergonomic workplace direction, so with no negative evidence yet the low carrying cost favors keeping the option open.
This new-generation general interior luminaire is actively promoted as newly arrived and belongs to the core business, so it is unlikely to be dropped within a year.
As a flagship microprismatic pendant aligned with the firm's direction, its value is still unfolding, and abandoning it early would destroy strategic option value.

HMI searchlights face substitution by LED within the firm's LED-focused strategy, which raises the drop risk, but marine product cycles are long and carrying costs are low, so keeping it is still preferred for now.
The marine searchlight serves a stable specialist niche with little evidence of failure, so the cheap option of keeping it on the market is retained.
